pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp pixel-to-pixel color gradients at the edges; large spatial area on the central flank transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries toward the limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways; junction nodes are predominantly triradiate with consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the 1D contour of the upper neck mane.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark avian figure is perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
